resolved_params.warmup_scope: No discarded pilots; identical source/dependency input pre-read before every measured sample. Existing protocol establishes resource requirements.
resolved_params.invalidation: mtime only; source bytes remain at the exact clean commit; require observed importer fan-out
resolved_params.build_storage: One disposable tmpfs build at /dev/shm/intrinsic-build009; disk-backed disposable source worktree at /tmp/intrinsic-build009/source; record available tmpfs/disk/host memory. No process-RSS attribution to tmpfs pages.
resolved_params.dependency_state: identical preinstalled vcpkg packages, no package installation during sampling
resolved_params.operating_system_cache: input pre-read, no cache flushing, no cold-filesystem claim
resolved_params.memory_measurement: GNU time maximum single-process RSS, not aggregate concurrent memory
resolved_params.critical_path: Ninja target DAG weighted by unfiltered per-invocation timings; unmatched meta-edges reported
resolved_params.summary: Per-scenario descriptive median and min/max from three samples per arm, all raw values and negative outcomes retained; no statistical or cross-host guarantee. Engine-library target excludes tests, Sandbox and GPU execution.
resolved_params.sample_sequence: Configure, clean, no-op, three implementation edits, config interface, snapshot interface, renderer interface; source bytes unchanged and tree retained within each sample. Recreate owned build tree between samples.
resolved_params.noise_scope: Normal desktop host; no CPU affinity/governor/turbo control. No competing compilation or tests; source inspection and remote review may run. Local descriptive comparison, not an isolated-machine or statistical claim.
resolved_params.configure_measurement: initial configure only; source iteration cohort deliberately excludes the already-measured reconfigure scenario.
